title: migrate OkHttp2 to OkHttp3
symptom: The project still uses deprecated OkHttp v2.x in some classes while many others use v3.x, which can cause strange problems.
cause: Using both major versions of OkHttp within a project can cause strange problems.
fix: Migrate the code using the deprecated version to v3, and follow the best practice of creating a single OkHttpClient instance shared throughout the application, using OkHttpClient.newBuilder() for customization.
evidence_quote: Using both major versions within a project can cause strange problems like https://github.com/square/okhttp/issues/2705. We should migrate the code using the deprecated version to v3.
